note: Game balance values for soldiers (not real-world data). Damage per hit = caliber base x zone multiplier; 100 HP per life. Loadout pools include sandbox / later-war weapons (StG 44, M3, FG 42): they are not a claim about 6 June 1944 issue.

kits.note: SW1: AI types Blaster troopers (trooper) and Robot commandos (robot): the soldier brain in the kit's body (content/characters/<model>.glb, local-only bakes; missing: the soldier body), carrying only the kit's weighted blasters (no sidearm, no grenades), on either side. robot: hp share, pace and aim-turn factors, hits spark instead of bleeding.

loadouts_operator.note: AI5: Operator bots (AiType::Operators) draw from these modern weapons instead of the faction pool and the class weapons: weighted primary, every lmgEvery-th operator on a side carries the LMG, all carry the sidearm; TK1: one in launcherEvery also carries the launcher, used on armour and heavy enemy types. Grenades stay the side's (no modern grenade is modelled). Battle Royale keeps its bare-hands start (royale loot rules).

operator_models_note: AI type Operators: soldiers (the same brain, weapons and procedural pose) wearing these bodies, one per AI in turn; a missing file leaves the faction's soldier body (tools/bake_ai_characters.py operators, docs/credits.md)
